item.title: BlackRock Bitcoin ETF outflows hit $1.66B over seven trading sessions
item.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs shed $201 million Monday, with seven straight sessions of net withdrawals from BlackRock’s IBIT totaling $1.66 billion.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Securitize agrees to buy River One to expand into asset-backed lending
item.description: Securitize agreed to buy River One to bring stablecoin funding to asset-backed lending and expects the deal to close in the fourth quarter of 2026.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today

item.title: Crypto exchanges need hard dollar caps on hot wallets, CertiK says
item.description: “Cold storage is a useful measure of online exposure, but it is not a standalone security score,” the cybersecurity firm told Cointelegraph.

item.title: OpenAI builds kill switch to stop rogue agents within 35 seconds

item.description: Both miners reported higher Bitcoin production but lower mining revenue and rising electricity costs as they expanded their AI infrastructure businesses.

item.title: Should you leave Australia to avoid paying 47% tax on crypto gains?
item.description: Some Australian crypto investors are moving overseas to avoid the huge CGT increase from July 2027. But there are also less drastic ways you can pay less tax.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Andrew Fenton

item.title: North Korean hackers create memecoins to launder funds from Binance hack: Elliptic
item.description: The blockchain firm traced stolen funds through six new tokens on NEAR, where hackers used liquidity pools to obscure transfers between wallets.

item.title: Formation Securities plans Solana stock trading venue under SEC exemption
item.description: The proposed venue would offer 24/7 trading of tokenized shares from Galaxy Digital, Exodus and Forward Industries, with a launch planned for early 2027.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Mercado Bitcoin begins post-hack reopening without a timeline for withdrawals
item.description: Customers can view their pre-hack balances as access returns in phases. The exchange has yet to say when withdrawals will resume.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Isabelle Castro

item.title: PNC Bank tests turning USDC payments into dollar deposits
item.description: The pilot lets eligible corporate and institutional clients accept USDC on Ethereum, with each token converted to one US dollar before deposit.

item.title: Avalanche’s AVAX leads crypto gains following NYSE tokenization deal
item.description: Avalanche’s AVAX token rose as much as 10% after the NYSE selected its blockchain to support settlement on a planned tokenized stock trading platform.

item.title: Bitcoin, tech stocks brush off Nvidia nerves as analyst mulls $68K target
item.description: Bitcoin rebounded from an 11-week low near $73,500 as the Nasdaq Composite rallied despite sell-off in Nvidia shares.

item.title: Analysts see no broader ‘contagion’ from $6.3B Binance hack

item.title: The $2.85B Binance hackers lost shows why the UK needs stablecoin freeze rules
item.description: The Binance hack proved stablecoin freezes work. Now the UK should make clear freeze rules a condition of listing coins.

item.title: Strategy buys 1,036 Bitcoin as BTC holdings climb to 850,364
item.description: Strategy bought $81.9 million in Bitcoin last week while spending $188.3 million repurchasing STRC preferred shares, according to its latest SEC filing.

item.title: EU taps industry to set standards for tokenized securities

item.title: Coinbase’s US national trust bank charter takes effect

item.title: Robinhood opens access to US IPOs for UK retail investors

item.title: BTC price eyes $73K amid Nvidia volatility: Three things to know in Bitcoin this week

item.title: Binance, Tether and Trump crypto firms face Senate records deadline
